integrity: All claims supported by explicit proof in RESULT.md; exact finite experiments replayable with verify.py. The review is same-model only, without independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: For n at least five. Full endomorphism normal forms and qualitative multiplication were published earlier; newly counted are parity-stratified rooted-fiber pages and labeled maximal commuting retractions. Exceptional n=4 is not addressed; a full historical equivalence search, including complete 1998 source text, remains incomplete. Finite checks n<=6 are not a proof of all n.
title: Commuting retractions of finite full transformation semigroups: a rooted-fiber graph and exact triangle enumerator
